description: Assess reachable database services — PostgreSQL/MySQL/MSSQL/MongoDB/Redis — for unauthenticated access, weak/default accounts, over-broad grants, and dangerous features (xp_cmdshell, COPY FROM PROGRAM, UDF, Redis file write) that turn a DB login into OS code execution. Load when recon shows 3306/5432/1433/6379/27017, leaked app config yields DB creds, or a database review is in scope. Signals: 0.0.0.0 bind, unauth Redis PONG, mysql.user host '%', FILE priv, secure_file_priv empty, xp_cmdshell.
